fields.raw: 2 bottles of good cream. 6 yolks of eggs. 2 lbs sugar. mix the yolks & sugar. put the cream on a fire in a coffee-pot, first putting in a stick of vanilla. then near boiling take it off & pour it gently into the mixture of eggs & sugar. stir it well. put it on the fire again stirring it thoroughly with a spoon to prevent it's sticking to the coffee-pot. then near boiling take it off and strain it through a towel. put it in the Salbthiere. then set it in ice an hours before it is to be served. put into the ice a handful of salt, or a large piece of ice. put ice all round the Salbthiere. i.e. a layer of ice a layer of salt for three layers. put salt on the coverlid of the Salbthiere & cover the hole with ice. leave it still half quarter of an hour. then turn the Salbthiere in the ice 10 minutes. open it to loosen with a spatulate the ice from the inner sides of the Salbthiere. shut it & replace it in the ice. open it from time to time to detach the ice from the sides. then well taken (gr
